# Triviq

Triviq is an independent product and engineering studio building websites, apps, SaaS platforms and digital experiences for businesses worldwide. Based in India, working worldwide.

## Services
- Web & Platforms
- Mobile Apps
- SaaS Products
- AI & Automation
- Business Software
- Games & Interactive
